collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager has had the hiccups for an hour, and a friend knows a cure that has never failed.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has had the hiccups for an hour. (friend) knows exactly how to cure them: you hold your breath, turn round three times, and say the name of a fish with every hiccup. It's never failed. (friend) is very confident about this.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "I'll just wait," says (subject). (friend) looks hurt. The hiccups go on. And on. Eventually, just to stop (friend) looking at (subject.him/her), (subject) tries the cure. On the second fish name, the hiccups stop. (subject) can't tell if it worked or if they'd have stopped anyway. (friend) can tell. It worked.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) holds (subject.his/her) breath. Turns round three times. Hiccups. "Grouper." Hiccups. "Snapper." Hiccups. "...Small grey one." By the time (subject.he/she) runs out of fish names, (subject.he/she) is laughing too hard to hiccup. Whether that was the cure, (friend) refuses to say. (friend.He/She) just looks very satisfied.
